sloka: विवर्जितो नरै: पापैर्मम पूर्वै: सुरक्षित: ।कच्चिज्जनपद: स्फीत: सुखं वसति राघव ॥ २.१००.४७॥
transliteration: vivarjito narai: pāpairmama pūrvai: surakṣita: ।kaccijjanapada: sphīta: sukhaṁ vasati rāghava ॥ 2.100.47॥

translations.english: I trust all those men who live on agriculture and cattlerearing are favourable to you. The world's prosperity, dear brother, grows on the profession of cattle rearing.
